name: EU AI Act & Algorithmic Impact Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689), NYC Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT Local Law 144), and Colorado AI Act, covering High-Risk AI System risk management, bias audit testing, technical documentation, human oversight, and CE mark attestation.

checklists.name: EU AI Act & Algorithmic Ethics Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for EU AI Act Articles 8-15 requirements and NYC Local Law 144.

items.statement: AI system is evaluated to verify it does NOT deploy cognitive behavioral manipulation, social scoring, or real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces (Art. 5).
Risk Management System (Art. 9) is established, implemented, documented, and updated throughout the high-risk AI system lifecycle.
Training, validation, and testing datasets meet quality criteria regarding data governance, bias prevention, and relevance (Art. 10).
Human Oversight mechanisms enable human-in-the-loop operators to override or stop AI system outputs (Art. 14).
Independent bias audit measures disparate impact ratios across protected groups prior to deployment (NYC LL144 / Art. 10).

reviewGates.name: EU AI Act Compliance Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The AI Officer and Ethics Committee attest that risk management, data governance, and human oversight controls satisfy the EU AI Act.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the AI governance documentation confirm compliance with the EU AI Act and bias audit requirements?

obligationDefinitions.title: High-risk AI systems require ongoing post-market monitoring, not a one-time conformity assessment
obligationDefinitions.description: The EU AI Act requires a post-market monitoring system for high-risk AI systems that tracks real-world performance and incidents after deployment; a conformity assessment passed at launch does not satisfy this ongoing duty.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Post-market monitoring data is reviewed on the declared cadence, and any serious incident is reported within the Act's required timeframe.

requiredEvidence.title: Post-market monitoring report
requiredEvidence.description: Review of the high-risk AI system's post-market performance and incident data.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Post-market monitoring system export, reviewed on a recurring cadence.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has post-market monitoring data been reviewed on schedule, with any serious incident reported on time?
